name: Sakana Marlin research agent adds Twilight 2.0 and Midnight 2.0 modes and a rebuilt slide-deck harness
title: Sakana Marlin research agent adds Twilight 2.0 and Midnight 2.0 modes and a rebuilt slide-deck harness
summary: Sakana's strategy research agent gains a faster multi-angle mode and a broadest-search mode, keeps the old mode as Sunlight, and now builds PowerPoint decks with a dedicated agent that renders and checks its own slides.
